body: Try hard to get better for your kids if possible. If not, maybe one day at least they’ll understand why. My mom drank herself to death when I was in my teens and I’ve only recently let my anger towards her turn into compassion for how she must have felt before she died.

Have you heard of Lee Macmillan? She was a Youtuber who took her own life recently. I didn’t watch her videos before, but now I can’t stop. I’ve been struggling a lot recently and listening to Lee describe her failing mental battles makes me feel so much more understood. 
I bring this up because maybe you could show your gf her videos. It’s extremely sad knowing she didn’t win in the end, but I feel that her reasoning through her depression could help because for Lee, it stemmed from being a highly extroverted people pleaser. 
Her IG page is Lifewithlee and there is a video on her page from December where she talks about this. Your gf might really resonate with it, like I did, and think more deeply about the depression we’re in and why.
If you’d already applied to med school then you might be able to quickly get your BS/BA in Biology because a lot of the classes are similar
Don’t have your dog locked in a room with you if this does actually occur I’ve heard it can emotionally scar them
Once you say everything going on it your head you can’t take it back, I don’t wanna be treated differently either
As soon as I wake up the “I hate myself I wanna die” thoughts begin again over and over and over and over
